protocol.availability: strictly next observed session after published date
protocol.rule: each new WHO PHEIC declaration, irrespective of subsequent market outcome
protocol.established_after: v1 market-model results observed; hypothesis is hindsight-informed
protocol.score_interpretation: binary contextual watch, never a calibrated probability

source_events.title: WHO initial H1N1 emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: the Director-General has determined that the current events constitute a public health emergency of international concern

source_events.title: WHO polio international-spread emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: on 5 May 2014 declared the international spread of wild poliovirus in 2014 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

source_events.title: WHO West African Ebola emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: on 8 August 2014 declared the Ebola outbreak in West Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

source_events.title: WHO neurological-cluster emergency associated with Zika
source_events.evidence_excerpt: constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
source_events.source_context: The declared event was the cluster of microcephaly and other neurological disorders, associated with Zika; not an assertion that every Zika infection is a PHEIC.

source_events.title: WHO eastern DRC Ebola emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

source_events.title: WHO novel-coronavirus emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: The Director-General declared that the outbreak of 2019-nCoV constitutes a PHEIC
source_events.source_context: This is the January PHEIC decision, not the later March pandemic characterization. Meeting hours are reported, but an exact first-publication timestamp is not established here.

source_events.title: WHO first mpox emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: I have decided that the global monkeypox outbreak represents a public health emergency of international concern.

source_events.title: WHO renewed mpox emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: This PHEIC determination is the second in two years relating to mpox.

source_events.title: WHO Bundibugyo Ebola emergency decision
source_events.evidence_excerpt: constitutes a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), but does not meet the criteria of pandemic emergency
source_events.source_context: The WHO page records a later correction to a reported Kinshasa case. Only the declaration and displayed date are used; case counts are not reconstructed from the revised page.

events.provenance: Lehman Brothers bankruptcy; the global transmission date. Alternative: 2008-01-21, the Indian market's own crash, which precedes the global event by eight months and would test a different phenomenon.
Bernanke's taper testimony; the trigger for the emerging-market outflow episode that hit the rupee and Indian equities.
IL&FS default cascade and the single-day NBFC selloff; the domestic shadow-banking shock.
Onset of the global COVID selloff, chosen so the 30-day window covers the drawdown. Alternative: 2020-03-23, the Indian market bottom, which would place the window over the recovery instead.
Start of the 2022 global tightening drawdown. Alternative: 2022-06-16, the peak-hawkishness repricing.

PROVISIONAL - SPEC OQ3 is explicitly open. Placeholder for the Feb-2026 interim framework; the 50% peak and the solar CVD single-day drop are the other candidates. MUST be resolved before Epoch 6 results are reported.

limitations: Historical counterfactual scenario, not evidence that this policy existed or was chosen before COVID.
The public announcement identifies a health emergency. It does not establish an impending financial crisis, causal market effect, or probability of loss.
The 20-session watch duration was chosen after seeing market-only results; sensitivity and prospective validation remain required. All declarations stay in the audit.
Next-session availability from a page date approximates dissemination; publication timestamps and immutable as-of archives are incomplete.
Unmatched health watches are labelled false only relative to the six provisional project market-event labels; these are not a universal inventory of financial crises.
The external watch is additional context. It does not repair or validate the market-only three-pillar onset model.
